desc.zh-TW: 殘牆靜立，風穿過古老的石縫。
desc.en: Wind slips through the stones of silent ruins.

desc.zh-TW: 樹影交疊，葉間漏下斑駁微光。
desc.en: Dappled light filters through overlapping boughs.

desc.zh-TW: 水聲伴著微風，輕拂河畔。
desc.en: Water murmurs beneath a gentle riverside breeze.

desc.zh-TW: 草浪漫過起伏山脊，天際遼闊。
desc.en: Grass ripples along ridges beneath a wide sky.

desc.zh-TW: 潮聲迴盪，海風帶來鹹濕氣息。
desc.en: Salt air and rolling surf fill the coast.

desc.zh-TW: 環形峭壁圍攏寂靜的坑底。
desc.en: Ringed cliffs enclose a quiet crater floor.

desc.zh-TW: 冰層延向遠方，寒光映著天色。
desc.en: Cold light glints across an expanse of ice.
Wind echoes between layers of canyon rock.
